provenance.reference_simulator: DWSIM version 9.0.5.0 (10/02/2025 23:49:46): Reactor_Equilibrium (K from its Gibbs energies), Reactor_Gibbs (DirectMinimization, IPOPT off), Reactor_Conversion; ideal-gas runs on Raoult's Law (no Poynting/Henry) with every vapour pressure multiplied by exp(PSAT_SHIFT) so nothing condenses; energy runs on Peng-Robinson. 'dwsim' runs use DWSIM's database compounds (ChemSep / ChEDL Thermo / User), 'hypo' runs hypothetical compounds on difflow's Hf, S (as Gf), Cp and critical constants. DWSIM's reactors take P0 = 101325 Pa and R = 8.314.
